items.title: ByteDance Draws Over $30 Billion in Orders for Jumbo Bank Loan

items.title: Bath & Body Works rises as Citi upgrades stock ahead of earnings
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi upgraded Bath & Body Works to Buy from Neutral ahead of the retailer’s second-quarter results next week, citing expectations for an earnings beat, a depressed stock price and potential upside from energy prices and tariff refunds. This combination of factors "creates a very attractive risk/reward" heading into the print, the bank’s analysts said.
